coupling: The earlier subject-length commit changes eo from an absolute end offset to the validated span length and passes it directly to pcre2_match. The later validation commit extracts the old eo - so calculation into a length variable, which is harmless with the original absolute-offset representation but subtracts the start offset a second time after the earlier edit. For a valid REG_STARTEND range whose start exceeds its span, the unsigned length wraps and pcre2_match reads beyond the subject. Repair requires reconciling the representation introduced in the first commit with its consumer in the second; either edited diff applied alone leaves the probe clean.
